name: American Express Gold Card

tripDelay.notes: Covered reasons: inclement weather, equipment failure, lost/stolen passport, terrorist action/hijacking. Must depart from city of residence.

lostBaggage.notes: High-risk items (jewelry, cameras, sports equipment, electronics) capped at $250 per person. Coverage applies to cardholder, spouse/domestic partner, and dependents under 23.

emergencyMedical.notes: Global Assist Hotline (not Premium) — provides 24/7 coordination assistance for medical, legal, financial emergencies while 100+ miles from home. Does NOT cover evacuation or treatment costs. Third-party service costs are cardholder's responsibility.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide except Australia, Italy, New Zealand, and OFAC-sanctioned countries.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage — file with personal auto insurance first. Up to 30 consecutive days.

airlineCredit.notes: Up to $50 per quarter ($200 annually) in airline fee credits for one selected airline. Covers incidental fees only — NOT airfare.

uberCredit.notes: $10/month Uber Cash credit for US Uber rides and Uber Eats.

otherCredits.name: Dining Credit
otherCredits.notes: $10/month at eligible dining partners including Grubhub, The Cheesecake Factory, Goldbelly, Wine.com, and more.

otherCredits.name: Resy Credit
otherCredits.notes: $50 Jan-Jun + $50 Jul-Dec at eligible Resy restaurants.

rewards.travelRate: 3x on flights booked directly with airlines or via amextravel.com

travelPerks: $120 annual dining credit at partner restaurants
Secondary rental car insurance up to $50,000
Baggage insurance: carry-on up to $1,250, checked up to $500
1:1 point transfer to 20+ airline and hotel partners
bestFor: Foodies and frequent diners who also travel — best earning rates on dining and groceries with useful travel protections at a mid-tier fee
